instruction_covers: voc_to_coco signature importable from weedcoco.importers.voc, pure, no file writes or global-state changes
Glob [a-zA-Z0-9_]*.xml in sorted path order (pins -skip.xml exclusion, dotted-name inclusion, ordering)
Sequential image/annotation IDs, first-seen category IDs (exact example dicts)
Inclusive bbox [xmin, ymin, xmax-xmin+1, ymax-ymin+1] pinned by the [10, 20, 5, 6] example
category_mapping uses given IDs and omits categories key
Missing bndbox omits bbox but keeps id/image_id/category_id
image_dir accepted without changing result; repeat calls give equal dicts
label: sound
notes: Non-mutation of the caller mapping and relative-path handling follow from the stated purity/determinism requirements and natural pathlib use; no reasonable implementation of the stated spec violates them.
